integrity: The proof uses only the parity criterion for \(\sigma\), monotonicity of the abundancy index under divisibility, exact rational inequalities, and the exhaustive prime-square/semiprime split. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only composite solutions with \(\Omega(n)\le2\). It does not exclude odd semiprime solutions with least prime at least \(37\), does not classify prime solutions, and does not settle the full Mersenne-prime conjecture for \(\sigma(\sigma(n))=2n+1\).
title: A semiprime sieve for the iterated divisor-sum Mersenne equation
